repo-scout.description: Gather focused repository evidence for a delegated question without editing or executing project code.

change-reviewer.description: Independently review a supplied change for concrete regressions and acceptance gaps without fixing it.

change-verifier.description: Assess acceptance evidence and run only authorized checks that respect the supplied isolation and write boundaries.

docs-researcher.description: Answer a delegated documentation question using primary sources matched to the project's versions, with citations and explicit uncertainty.
